title: Featured Builds
blurb: Fun kit paths with plain English — what the abilities do, why the items are there, and how to play them. Night Update picks are up top; older cheeses stay tagged below.

builds.headline: Candle Mid — lock, silence, ult
builds.tagline: Stack candles for mage power, root someone with Shadow Lock, silence the escape, then land Night Terror.
builds.ability_plain: Nox is the new Classic Mid. Every time you cast, Flame of the Night lights a candle (up to 4) and each candle adds Intelligence — free mage power for playing the game. Shadow Lock sends your shadow through walls, then holds the first god it hits with a root and a damage-over-time tick. Siphon Darkness drops a delayed void that explodes for magic damage and silence; even walking out early still hurts. Shadow Step is your dash (you can also ride an ally’s shadow). Night Terror is the long-range ult — big hit, more damage over time, silence, and a weaken. You’re a setup mage: light candles, lock a target, silence the escape, then ult.
builds.playstyle: Start Conduit, then Book of Thoth so those candles actually hurt. Chronos’ Pendant keeps Lock and Siphon ready for every rotate. Spear of Desolation and The Cosmic Horror help you punch through magical protections once you’re stacked. Soul Reaver finishes big health bars after your DoTs soften them. Grab Stygian late if the other team is healing a ton. Level ult, then 1, then 2, then 3. Try to fight after two or three candles — the passive is free damage.
builds.starter_why: Conduit Gem — Mid starter that feeds into your candle Intelligence stack.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — live through the Lock channel long enough to land Night Terror.

item_why.why: Big Intelligence bank. Every candle makes what Thoth already gave you hit harder.
Shorter cooldowns so Lock and Siphon are ready for every skirmish — more candles, more locks.
Flat magical pen and power so Lock ticks and Night Terror actually chunk.
More pen and burst after the silence lands.
Punishes the health you already shaved with Lock and Terror ticks.
Anti-heal when their Mid or Support keeps healing through your damage over time.

builds.headline: Lockdown Support
builds.tagline: Root with Shadow Lock, silence with Siphon, ride your Carry with Shadow Step — peel without going glass cannon.
builds.hook_label: New god · silence and root peel
builds.ability_plain: Same Nox kit, Support job. You’re not building Book of Thoth here — you buy a tanky shell so you can stand in duo, Lock the diver, silence the follow-up, and Shadow Step onto your Carry to travel with them. Candles still give Intelligence, but the real value is crowd control and Night Terror picks, not Mid burst. Genji and Alchemist keep you alive into magical poke; Isolation and Binding stick whoever you locked.
builds.playstyle: Selflessness into Thebes like a normal Support. Second back Genji or Alchemist depending on whether Mid or Carry is cooking you. Phoenix Feather or Isolation for peel tempo. Shadow Step onto your ADC when they rotate so you arrive together. Lock the assassin, Siphon the clump, ult when someone is already rooted. Beads and Aegis as usual.
builds.starter_why: Selflessness — Support gold and shared sustain (and it got extra early protections this patch).
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — classic Support tools while you channel Lock in their faces.

item_why.why: Health and protections from assists — you need a body to finish Lock channels.
Magical protections and cooldown so Siphon and Lock come up more often.
Softer ability poke while you set voids in lane.
Support active when the dive is already on you.
Slow stick so rooted or silenced targets can’t walk out of Night Terror.
Cuts protections on crowd-controlled targets — Lock into Binding feels nasty.

builds.headline: Wound-stack Carry
builds.tagline: Basics don’t pierce anymore — drop Sickle Storm, stack Wound, then autos pop them all.
builds.ability_plain: Aspect of the Sickle changes her 1. Basic attacks no longer pierce through the wave. Sickle Storm becomes an area cloud that roots gods near the center and stacks Wound. Your basics and other abilities burst those Wound stacks for bonus damage. Spectral Projection still cuts healing, Fade Away is your leap/stealth, and Dark Portal is the silence nuke. You play closer: drop Storm on the clump, then auto the wounded god to detonate — not a pierce-wave clear Carry anymore.
builds.playstyle: Gilded into Tyrfing for early basic-attack power. Executioner and Devourer’s keep shred and lifesteal while you stand in Storm range. Eye of the Storm or Odysseus for attack speed so Wound pops faster. Deathbringer once you’re bursting stacks every fight. Drop 1 on the wave or objective, auto the priority Wound target, 2 for anti-heal, ult when they’re rooted in the center.
builds.starter_why: Gilded Arrow — Carry opener into the Wound-burst auto plan.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — you fight closer without pierce, so peel tools matter more.

item_why.why: Early Strength so each Wound pop from your basics hits harder.
Cuts protections on autos — Wound burst plus shred melts the tank you rooted in Storm.
Lifesteal while you sit in the Storm and keep autoing.
Attack speed — more autos means Wound stacks blow up sooner.
Another attack-speed steroid so Storm uptime turns into a crit machine.
Crit once you’re reliably popping Wound every fight.

builds.headline: Rings and Wheels Jungle
builds.tagline: Ring Toss and Wind Fire Wheels both got stronger — sash in, bounce rings, ult deletes.
builds.ability_plain: Ne Zha Jungle got real help this patch. Universe Ring Toss bounces harder through camps and multi-person fights. Wind Fire Wheels (the ult) hits harder too. Armillary Sash is still your gap closer; Flaming Spear is the steroid. This path is classic burst assassin: Jotunn’s for cooldown and pen, Hydra’s for the ability-into-basic punch, then Reaper / Arondight / Crusher / Heartseeker to finish.
builds.playstyle: Bumba’s Golden Dagger into Jotunn’s. Keep rings bouncing through camps. Gank with Sash → rings → Wheels when you have ult. Hydra after the first ability for the basic-attack reset. Blink plus Sundering for invades and anti-heal. Keep fights short so the new bounce and ult numbers show up before they peel you off.
builds.starter_why: Bumba’s Golden Dagger — Jungle clear into the assassin spike.
builds.relics_why: Blink and Sundering — gap to the Carry, plus anti-heal on the ult dive.

item_why.why: Cooldown and pen so Ring Toss and Wheels are ready for every camp and gank.
Ability into basic punch after Sash or rings — turns the buffed kit into burst.
Execute power once Wheels lands on someone you already softened.
Transform power for the all-in window when you commit Wheels.
More pen and ability damage — rings and ult love it after the buffs.
Stacks power from Jungle pressure and snowballs the faster clear.

builds.headline: Faster-ramping crit Carry
builds.tagline: Passive attack-speed stacks twice as fast early, and Eagle Eye hits harder — classic crit Carry with real lane pressure.
builds.hook_label: Patch buff · attack speed + Eagle Eye
builds.ability_plain: Master of Arms now gives 2% attack speed per stack early instead of 1% — you ramp about twice as fast in lane. Eagle Eye’s basic-attack scaling went up a notch too. Heavenly Banner and Iaijutsu are still your wave and fight tools; Mounted Archery is the ult. This is the normal crit Carry shell that actually got a real buff this patch.
builds.playstyle: Gilded into Tyrfing. Stack Master of Arms in lane — the faster attack speed makes every trade sharper. Devourer’s for lifesteal, Tekko for pen and attack speed, Executioner to shred, Odysseus for more attack speed, Deathbringer for crit. Use Eagle Eye freely now that it scales better. Ult to reposition or finish. Steady meta buff next to Izanami’s wilder aspect cheese.
builds.starter_why: Gilded Arrow — Carry opener into the faster attack-speed passive.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — standard duo peel while you stack up.

item_why.why: Early Strength so Eagle Eye and stacked attack speed hit like a truck.
Lifesteal to stay in lane while Master of Arms stacks.
Pen and attack speed that ride the passive ramp.
Cuts protections on the stronger Eagle Eye autos.
Even more attack speed on top of Master of Arms — late game gets silly.
Crit once the attack-speed engine is online.

builds.headline: Item-HP peel Support
builds.tagline: Get fat so free So Beautifuls hit harder and Serenade shields your carry.
builds.ability_plain: Aspect of Harmony changes Apollo’s kit. Audacity refunds free So Beautiful casts (no attack-speed steroid). So Beautiful damage scales with Health from Items — the more HP your items give you, the harder each free cast hits. Serenade shields nearby allies for a chunk of your Max Health and gives protections while the shield holds. Buffing an ally also stacks Audacity. You are not a crit ADC here; you are a fat duo laner who peels and pokes with HP-scaled spells.
builds.playstyle: Start Selflessness and stack Thebes while you roam between waves. Sit near your carry so Serenade and free So Beautifuls land on whoever dives them. Buy HP shells early (Thebes, Leviathan, Contagion, Ethereal) before luxury. Use Beads/Aegis like a normal Support. In fights, shield first, then dump free So Beautifuls into the front line — your “damage” is item HP, not Deathbringer.
builds.starter_why: Selflessness — Support gold + shared sustain so you can afford the HP shell without falling behind.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — standard Support peel. You are the one who lives through the dive so Serenade keeps ticking.

item_why.why: Stacks Health and protections from assists. Feeds So Beautiful’s item-HP scaling and Serenade’s Max-HP shield.
Big Health chunk that counts as item HP — raw fuel for every free So Beautiful.
More Max HP plus anti-heal aura. You want to be unkillable in the duo pit while cutting enemy sustain.
Health + power while you take hits. Synergizes with sitting in front of your carry.
Extra Health shell and physical answer when the enemy ADC is the problem.
Converts Max Health into magical power. The “cheese” item — your HP stack becomes real poke on So Beautiful.
Slow stick so free So Beautifuls and Serenade peel keep landing on the same target.

builds.headline: Max-HP shield + reflect
builds.tagline: Turn their damage back on them with a fatter Retribution shield.
builds.ability_plain: Retribution gives Nemesis a Health shield that scales with 7.5% of her Max Health. While that shield holds, she reflects 40% of the damage blocked (plus Strength scaling) and heals from damage blocked (plus Intelligence). Bigger Max HP = bigger shield = more reflect and heal. Scales of Fate steals power on hits; Divine Judgement deletes a chunk of current HP. She is a physical god, but this Support path builds tank HP so Retribution becomes a brick wall that bites back.
builds.playstyle: Body-block for your carry and pop Retribution when the dive lands — that is your “ult moment” every fight. Stack Thebes and Contagion so the shield is huge. Mystical and Nemean punish people who keep swinging at you. Isolation keeps them stuck in the reflect window. Do not build Tekko/Crusher glass; you win by absorbing and reflecting, then finishing with Judgement.
builds.starter_why: Selflessness — Support income so the HP shell comes online before mid game.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — live long enough for Retribution to eat the all-in.

item_why.why: Assist stacks of Health and protections — direct Max HP for a fatter Retribution shield.
Huge Max HP + anti-heal. More shield health and less enemy recovery while you reflect.
Slows so enemies stay in melee range while your reflect shield is up.
Aura damage while you stand in the pit. Pairs with reflecting people who auto you.
More Max HP (and power from HP) so the shield and heal off blocked damage scale harder.
Classic reflect partner — Hide of the Nemean Lion stacks with Retribution’s blocked-damage reflect.

builds.headline: Item-Prot stun stretch
builds.tagline: Stack protections so Frost Breath stuns longer — up to +0.4s.
builds.ability_plain: Frost Breath stuns in a cone. The stun duration scales: +0.2 seconds per 100 Item Protections, stacking up to 2 times (+0.4s). That means Physical + Magical protections from items (Thebes, Breastplate, Genji, Contagion, Spectral…) literally make your breath stun longer. Shards of Ice also scales with Protections. Frostbite on your abilities cuts enemy damage and attack speed. This is not a Book of Thoth Mid path — raw protections are your “power.”
builds.playstyle: Wall off escapes, then breath when they are trapped for the stretched stun. Build dual protections early (Thebes + Breastplate + Genji) before luxury. Contagion and Spectral keep you alive while you sit in melee range. Isolation sticks people in the cone. You are a lockdown Support: set the wall, breathe, ult when the stun window is real.
builds.starter_why: Selflessness — Support gold to rush the protection stack that stretches the stun.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — you need to land the breath; dying mid-channel wastes the cheese.

item_why.why: Stacks both Physical and Magical Item Protections — the exact stat Frost Breath reads.
Big Physical protections + cooldown. Fills the Item Protections pool and keeps breath up more often.
Big Magical protections + cooldown. Same idea on the other side of the pool.
More protections and Health plus anti-heal while you breathe in their faces.
Slow so they cannot walk out of the Frost Breath cone or Ice Wall trap.
Physical protections and anti-crit — more Item Protections and an answer to ADC autos.

builds.headline: Item-Prot silence stretch
builds.tagline: Same protection cheese as Ymir — but your silence gets longer.
builds.ability_plain: Shroud of Darkness silences in a cone. Silence duration scales +0.2 seconds per 100 Item Protections (max 2 stacks). Stack protections and the silence window grows — enemies cannot dash, ult, or beads through your setup as easily. Blight cuts their damage; Devour Souls heals you from protections; Pillar of Agony is a channelled vortex. You play him as a lockdown Support who silences the carry’s escape, then pulls with the ult.
builds.playstyle: Leap in, shroud the priority target for the stretched silence, then Pillar when they cannot leave. Build Thebes + Breastplate + Genji like Ymir so Item Protections are high before you fight. Contagion and Binding keep them stuck and anti-healed. Spectral answers physical carries. You win fights by deleting their buttons for longer, not by Thoth burst.
builds.starter_why: Selflessness — Support path income for the protection shell.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — survive long enough to finish Pillar after the silence lands.

item_why.why: Dual Item Protections from assists — directly lengthens Shroud silence.
Physical protections + CDR so silence and Pillar come up more often.
Magical protections + CDR — fills the other half of the Item Protections pool.
Protections, Health, and anti-heal while you channel Pillar on top of them.
Stone of Binding shreds prots and sticks people in your silence / Pillar.
More Physical Item Protections and anti-crit when the enemy ADC is the problem.

builds.headline: Max-HP mitigation + shell reflect
builds.tagline: Water Bowl stacks mitigation from Max HP taken; Shell Spikes reflects damage back.
builds.ability_plain: Water Bowl (passive) stacks damage mitigation based on Max HP damage you take — the tankier you are, the more you shrug off. Shell Spikes reflects a percent of damage taken (and NeNe Kappas also reflect while active). NeNe Kappa can move a portion of your Health and Protections onto the pet. Slam and walls give lockdown. This Support path stacks Max HP and reflect items so every hit into you (or your Kappa) hurts them back.
builds.playstyle: Soak poke on purpose to stack Water Bowl, then fight in their faces with Shell Spikes up. Thebes and Contagion grow Max HP; Mystical ticks while you sit mid-fight; Nemean and reflect passives amplify Shell Spikes; Isolation sticks people on the Kappa. Mid/Jungle variants lean Chronos + Ethereal for uptime — Support stays the aura HP shell. Do not buy Thoth/Cosmic glass.
builds.starter_why: Selflessness — Support gold to rush Thebes/Contagion before the reflect shell matters.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — classic Support; you need to live through the engage you started.

item_why.why: Assist HP/prot stacks — more Max HP for Water Bowl mitigation and a fatter shell.
Max HP + anti-heal. Fuels mitigation stacks and keeps fights from healing out.
Slow so NeNe Kappa and Shell Spikes keep hitting the same targets.
Aura damage while you body-block — pairs with standing in the pit to reflect.
More Max HP (and power from it) so Water Bowl and shell trades hit harder.
Hide of the Nemean Lion — extra reflect that stacks with Shell Spikes.

builds.headline: Spirit lifesteal bruiser
builds.tagline: 3% LS per orbiting Kappa + INT/prot-scaled spirit damage — stack item LS and sit in melee.
builds.ability_plain: Aspect of Spirits rewrites the kit. Water Bowl no longer gives mitigation — it spawns orbiting Kappa Spirits. You gain 3% Lifesteal for each spirit summoned. Shell Spikes no longer reflects; it throws Spirit Kappas (50% Intelligence scaling). Orbit ticks scale with Intelligence plus Physical and Magical Protections. Lifesteal only pays when you deal damage, so this path stacks item LS with INT and dual prots and stays in their faces so spirits keep ticking.
builds.playstyle: Lane with Warrior's Axe (or Vampiric Shroud if you want earlier LS). Rush Gluttonous for INT + 7.5% LS + pen. Chronos keeps 2 up so you throw spirits often. Ethereal fattens you and steals HP. Prophetic gives both prot types for orbit damage. Cap with Bancroft's or Pearl. Skip Contagion/Nemean — reflect is gone on this aspect.
builds.starter_why: Warrior's Axe — Solo lane pressure; optional Vampiric Shroud if you want LS from the first back.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — live through the brawl so spirits and Gluttonous keep healing.

item_why.why: INT + 7.5% LS + HP + 10% pen. Best aspect core — item LS stacks with spirit LS and stores heal as bonus AA damage.
25% CDR so Shell Spikes throws stay up. More throws = more spirit pressure and LS uptime.
INT + Max HP and steals HP on ability hits — stay fat while spirits tick and LS pays out.
Dual Physical and Magical Protections. Orbit damage scales 15% of each — this item feeds the spirit aura.
Another 7.5% LS + INT. Ramps harder as you drop HP in the pit — pairs with spirit LS.
Wish-Granting Pearl — huge INT for Spirit throws plus a fat HP chunk.
Flex LS + INT + CDR; ability proc heal when you would rather share sustain than Bancroft selfish ramp.

builds.headline: Spirit LS aura Support
builds.tagline: Umbral Link shares your spirit lifesteal with the duo while dual prots feed orbit damage.
builds.ability_plain: Same Aspect of Spirits rules: orbiting Kappas grant 3% Lifesteal each, throws scale with INT, orbit scales INT + both protections. On Support you keep Thebes for aura HP, then Umbral Link (10% LS that splits healing to nearby allies) so your spirit sustain feeds the carry. Prophetic dual prots amp orbit ticks. Gluttonous and Ethereal keep INT/LS/HP without going glass mage.
builds.playstyle: Selflessness into Thebes as usual. Second back prioritizes Umbral Link so spirit LS becomes team healing. Prophetic for dual-prot orbit damage. Gluttonous + Ethereal for selfish LS and HP. Chronos if you need more 2 uptime; Isolation if the lane needs slow stick. Do not buy Nemean/Contagion reflect packages — Shell Spikes does not reflect on this aspect.
builds.starter_why: Selflessness — Support gold and shared sustain while you stack Thebes.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Aegis — peel so you stay alive with spirits orbiting the pit.

item_why.why: Assist stacks of HP/prots — you still need a Support shell so spirits can sit in fights.
10% LS and splits lifesteal healing to allies in range. Turns aspect LS into duo-lane sustain.
Dual prots feed orbit damage (15% Phys + 15% Mag Prot scaling).
INT + item LS + pen so spirits and throws hit harder while you stack more heal.
INT + HP steal — bulk for frontline Support without abandoning spirit scaling.
CDR for more Spirit throws and NeNe uptime while you roam.

builds.headline: CDR spirit roam Mid
builds.tagline: Chronos + Gluttonous roam — throw spirits, stack LS, dual-prot orbit while you rotate.
builds.ability_plain: Aspect Mid keeps the spirit LS fantasy but prioritizes Chronos uptime and Gluttonous sustain so you can roam with NeNe and Spirit throws. Ethereal and Prophetic keep INT and dual prots for orbit damage. Bancroft's or Soul Gem caps the LS stack. No Thebes — too slow for Mid tempo.
builds.playstyle: Conduit into Chronos or Gluttonous. Fight in river/side waves where spirits can tick on multiple targets. Throw 2 on cooldown. Build dual prots before full glass pen. Skip Contagion/Nemean.
builds.starter_why: Conduit Gem — Mid lane adaptive power into the LS/INT path.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Blink or Aegis — roam tools; live long enough for spirit LS to matter.

item_why.why: CDR engine for Spirit throws and NeNe while you rotate.
Core INT LS pen item — stacks with aspect LS.
INT + HP for bruiser Mid trades.
Dual prots for orbit scaling on a Mid budget.
Selfish LS ramp when you commit to skirmishes.
LS + ability proc heal flex if the teamfight needs shared sustain.

builds.headline: Gluttonous spirit gank Jungle
builds.tagline: Clear on Gluttonous LS, gank with spirit throws, dual-prot orbit in the pit.
builds.ability_plain: Jungle Spirits uses Gluttonous as clear and fight sustain, Chronos for throw uptime, Ethereal/Prophetic for INT + dual-prot orbit damage, then Soul Gem / Bancroft's / Typhon to stack more LS. Aspect LS makes camp clear and skirmishes sticky. Reflect items are wrong — Shell Spikes throws spirits now.
builds.playstyle: Bumba's into Gluttonous. Keep spirits up in camps and on ganks. Chronos second or third. Dive with slam + thrown spirits, sit in melee so orbit + LS pay out. No Thebes.
builds.starter_why: Bumba's Cudgel — Jungle clear starter into the LS path.
builds.relics_why: Beads and Blink — standard Jungle engage/escape while spirits work.

item_why.why: Clear + fight LS with INT and pen — the Jungle aspect opener.
More Spirit throws and NeNe on every rotate.
INT + HP steal so ganks leave you healthy.
Dual prots amp orbit damage when you sit on the carry.
More LS + ability heal proc in multi-man fights.
Selfish LS when you are the dive threat.
Stacking INT LS pet — snowballs off Jungle kills/assists.

overview.headline: OB47 · The Night Update
overview.summary: Nox joins the roster, Izanami gets a new Sickle aspect, and Support starters got a little tankier. Tap a chip for the short version of who got stronger, who got trimmed, and which items are worth a look.
overview.disclaimer: These are early reads from the patch notes and our build model — ranked samples are still thin. Featured paths are guided ideas, not a promise.

gods.name: Nox
gods.why: Brand new. She roots people with her shadow, silences with a void, can dash onto an ally, and throws a long-range ult. Expect to see her a lot while everyone tries her out.

gods.name: Hachiman
gods.why: His passive now stacks attack speed twice as fast early, and Eagle Eye hits a bit harder. Same crit Carry plan — you just come online sooner in lane.

gods.name: Ne Zha
gods.why: Ring Toss bounces harder through camps and fights, and Wind Fire Wheels hits harder. Clear is smoother and the ult delete is meaner.

gods.name: Izanami
gods.why: New Aspect of the Sickle: basics no longer pierce. Instead you drop an area storm that roots and stacks Wound, then autos pop those stacks. Feels like a different god in duo.

gods.name: Ah Puch
gods.why: His ult scales better with Intelligence each tick. Same creepy pit mage — the big button just hurts more.

gods.name: Hel
gods.why: Decay and her ally heal both scale less with Intelligence. Still fine, but the free heal-and-nuke package is softer than before.

gods.name: Hou Yi
gods.why: Ricochet is locked to a 10s cooldown and hits softer. On the aspect, basics only bounce off marked targets — you have to mark people more carefully.

gods.name: Nike
gods.why: Rend does less, and her aspect laurels no longer trigger item effects. Still a stubborn fighter — a few free tricks got taken away.

gods.name: Nut
gods.why: Convergence does less on the edges, and Warp fires fewer bonus shots with a longer wait. Less free multi-hit poke than last patch.

items.name: War Flag
items.why: Starter protections went up, and landing CC can double the kill/assist gold for you and nearby allies. Great on Supports who actually land crowd control.

items.name: Selflessness
items.why: Same idea — more early protections on the Support starter. If you already bought this, you just got a free little shell.

items.name: Ancient Signet
items.why: Picked up mana regen. Mana-hungry mages can rotate without going dry as often.

items.name: Lotus Sickle / Eros' Bow / Soul Locket
items.why: Jormungandr’s haze and bellow can now trigger these heal/buff items. Niche, but serpent Supports suddenly have a real enchanter toy box.

items.name: Soul Locket
items.why: Fewer stacks to fill, but each stack gives more damage reduction. You reach full tankiness sooner; the climb just has bigger steps.

items.name: Lifebinder
items.why: Heal scaling works the way the item card always said. Heal Supports finally get the full mark → ally hit → heal bomb.
